outputAccounting.correctnessHashBufferOutsidePerformance: Temporarily adds a full canonical plane buffer; never claim it is free

performanceTransformCandidates.videoOutputDownscale: Explicitly declared per profile; does not automatically reduce source AV1 entropy/reference decoding

extremeCases: Source validity/native absence/automatic demux/decoded fidelity/streaming performance are separate records. NUT FFV1+TrueHD and AVI+ASS are not invented into validity.
admissionRule: Exact profile, artifact and budget must exist before production activation. These proposed controls cannot guarantee all valid bitrates, resolutions, codec profiles or subtitle programs.
